meta.title: Request several materials in one intake and delete a row

plan.title: Add and delete intake material row

args.goal: On the request-material intake screen with one material row already filled, click the next row and fill a second material; verify that a new blank row is added after the filled row, then click the red bin icon for one material row and verify that the binned row is deleted and only the kept material rows remain.

steps.note: The catalog has no domain step for this intake grid's automatic blank-row creation or red-bin deletion, so perform and verify the complete behavior directly on screen.
Confirm the final intake screen has no rendering errors or broken values after the row addition and deletion.
